title: Customer outreach timeline and action items for regional capacity regression
creator: Benji Carter
description: Summary: On 2026-03-07 we observed a regional capacity regression that caused elevated latencies and intermittent 502/503 errors for hosted API customers in eu-west-1 for ~3 hours. This ticket collects the customer-facing timeline, status-page wording, action items assigned to engineering and support, and follow-up tasks for billing and SLO reconciliation. Objective: produce a single-source-of-truth closure artifact that can be linked from the public status page and customer emails, and capture owners/due dates for remediation work.

2026-03-07T01:17Z - Automated autoscaler error spikes seen; several scale-up requests returned 500s from orchestration service
2026-03-07T01:25Z - Pager duty triggered; oncall (Priya Nair) paged; mitigations started (manual capacity increase and traffic reroute to eu-central-1)
2026-03-07T01:40Z - Initial customer notification published to status page (see 'status_message_initial' below)
2026-03-07T02:05Z - Mitigation effective: latency began trending down as manual capacity took effect; partial routing to fallback region reduced error rate

2026-03-07T03:15Z - Root cause hypothesis formed: orchestration scaler experienced a race in scale-down path creating orphaned allocation entries; cluster capacity reports diverged from actual VM pool
2026-03-07T03:55Z - Engineers rolled an immediate fix to orchestration logic (hotfix-pr #14598) to re-sync allocation state; verification started
2026-03-07T04:22Z - Service reported healthy; status page updated to 'identified & mitigating' then 'service restored'
2026-03-07T07:00Z - Incident declared resolved for customer-facing channels; internal monitoring kept under watch for 48 hours
status_message_initial: We are investigating increased latency and errors in eu-west-1 affecting text-generation and embeddings APIs. Our engineers are actively mitigating and routing traffic to alternate regions where possible. We will provide updates every 30 minutes until resolved. - Redwood Inference Status
status_message_update: Mitigation in progress: we've increased capacity in eu-west-1 and are routing a portion of traffic to eu-central-1 while we diagnose the root cause. Some customers may experience degraded performance. We expect further updates within 30 minutes. - Redwood Inference Status
status_message_resolved: Resolved: Traffic routing and orchestration fixes have restored service in eu-west-1. We will follow up with a detailed timeline and corrective actions. If you continue to see issues, please contact support. - Redwood Inference Status
root_cause_summary: Root cause: A race condition in the orchestration autoscaler scale-down path caused allocation lease records to remain in a transient state. The orchestration control plane reported available capacity greater than what worker VMs actually had, preventing new allocations and causing request throttling and elevated latencies.

Contributing factors: recent optimization to concurrent scale operations (PR #14211) reduced locking around allocation state which inadvertently allowed an inconsistent state to persist during simultaneous scale-down and rebalancing operations.

Why it wasn't caught by automated tests: Integration tests did not include a multi-tenant concurrent scale-down + rebalance scenario that reproduces the specific timing window. Load tests used synthetic sequence lengths vs customer sequence distribution which shortened the KV-cache hold times and masked the leak path.

Increased monitoring and alerting thresholds added for allocation divergence metrics

customer_outreach_plan: Tiered outreach: 1) public status page post linking to this ticket and brief FAQ; 2) targeted email to top-25 impacted customers with timeline, technical summary, and next steps; 3) account-team phone outreach for enterprise customers with SLAs.
Message cadence: send initial status updates from oncall, send resolved + follow-up email within 48 hours, send final RCA + remediation commitments within 7 business days.
Escalation: any customer reporting continued impact after resolved should be escalated to Support Escalations and assigned a dedicated engineer.
